items.headline: Carrick says United need more signings before window closes September 1
items.summary: Michael Carrick confirms Manchester United want and need additional transfers after signing Santos, Tielemans, and Darlow.

items.headline: Manchester United lose 2-4 to AC Milan in final pre-season friendly
items.summary: United suffer defeat to AC Milan in Wroclaw, raising questions before Premier League season begins next week.

items.headline: Maguire urges Rashford to stay at Manchester United
items.summary: Harry Maguire makes passionate plea for Marcus Rashford to remain as transfer deadline approaches, calling him vital to squad.

items.headline: Rashford makes return in AC Milan friendly after 8-month absence
items.summary: Marcus Rashford introduced in second half of AC Milan match after long absence due to Amorim loan spell and Barcelona.

items.headline: INEOS may reverse Rashford number 14 decision after Romano deletion
items.summary: Transfer journalist Fabrizio Romano deletes announcement that Rashford would wear No.14, indicating potential club U-turn.
